info.title: a2b Logistics Public Agent Readiness API
info.description: Read-only public data and MCP-style inquiry-preparation API for a2b Logistics. No endpoint submits forms, sends email, or creates commercial commitments.

get.description: Schema for preparing an inquiry draft. It does not submit or contact a2b.

post.description: Supports initialize, tools/list, tools/call, resources/list, and resources/read JSON-RPC-style requests. Tools are read-only and require explicit user approval before any external contact outside this API.

x-a2b-approval-requirements: No public endpoint sends email, submits forms, calls phone numbers, or creates commitments.
Agents must ask for explicit user approval before contacting a2b.
Careers, vendors, internships, training, spam, retail shopping, consumer courier, and unrelated requests must not be routed to project inquiry.
